name: MonomialOrder.IsGroebnerBasis.iff_subset_and_degree_le_eq_and_degree_le
statement:
theorem iff_subset_and_degree_le_eq_and_degree_le
    {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R))
    (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, IsUnit (m.leadingCoeff g)) :
    m.IsGroebnerBasis G I ↔
      G ⊆ I ∧ ∀ p ∈ I, p ≠ 0 → ∃ g ∈ G, m.degree g ≤ m.degree p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    exists h.subset
    intro p hp hp0
    apply Set.mem_image_of_mem m.leadingTerm at hp
    apply Ideal.subset_span at hp
    rw [h.span_leadingTerm_image, SetLike.mem_coe,
      m.span_leadingTerm_eq_span_monomial (by simp_intro .. [hG]),
      ← Set.image_image (monomial · 1) _ _, mem_ideal_span_monomial_image,
      m.support_leadingTerm' hp0] at hp
    simpa using hp
  rintro ⟨hG', h_degree⟩
  rw [iff_subset]
  constructor
  · exact hG'
  intro p' hp
  rcases hp with ⟨p, hp', hp'₁⟩
  rw [←hp'₁, leadingTerm, SetLike.mem_coe,
    m.span_leadingTerm_eq_span_monomial (by simp_intro .. [hG]),
    ← Set.image_image (monomial · 1) _ _, mem_ideal_span_monomial_image]
  intro j hj
  specialize h_degree p
  simp_all [MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff]

lemma subset {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} {I} (h : m.IsGroebnerBasis G I) : G ⊆ I := h.1

lemma span_leadingTerm_image {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} {I} (h : m.IsGroebnerBasis G I) :
    Ideal.span (m.leadingTerm '' ↑I) = Ideal.span (m.leadingTerm '' G) := h.2

lemma iff_subset (G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    m.IsGroebnerBasis G I ↔
      G ⊆ I ∧ m.leadingTerm '' ↑I ⊆ (Ideal.span (m.leadingTerm '' G) : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h.span_leadingTerm_image]
    exact ⟨h.subset, Ideal.subset_span⟩
  intro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  refine ⟨h₁, ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · rwa [Ideal.span_le]
  apply Ideal.span_mono
  exact Set.image_mono h₁

  simp [IsGroebnerBasis, m.span_leadingTerm_sdiff_singleton_zero]

    m.IsGroebnerBasis G I ↔
      G ⊆ I ∧ ∀ p ∈ I, p ≠ 0 → ∃ g ∈ G, m.degree g ≤ m.degree p := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    exists h.subset
    intro p hp hp0
    apply Set.mem_image_of_mem m.leadingTerm at hp
    apply Ideal.subset_span at hp
    rw [h.span_leadingTerm_image, SetLike.mem_coe,
      m.span_leadingTerm_eq_span_monomial (by simp_intro .. [hG]),
      ← Set.image_image (monomial · 1) _ _, mem_ideal_span_monomial_image,
      m.support_leadingTerm' hp0] at hp
    simpa using hp
  rintro ⟨hG', h_degree⟩
  rw [iff_subset]
  constructor

  intro p' hp
  rcases hp with ⟨p, hp', hp'₁⟩

    m.span_leadingTerm_eq_span_monomial (by simp_intro .. [hG]),
    ← Set.image_image (monomial · 1) _ _, mem_ideal_span_monomial_image]

  specialize h_degree p

  rw [← isGroebnerBasis_sdiff_singleton_zero,

  simp_intro .. [or_iff_not_imp_right.mp (hG _ _)]

    (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, IsUnit (m.leadingCoeff g) ∨ g = 0)

        ↑s ⊆ Set.range e ∧ m'.IsGroebnerBasis (rename e ⁻¹' G) (I.comap (rename e))) :
    m.IsGroebnerBasis G I := by
  rw [iff_subset_and_degree_le_eq_and_degree_le₀ (hG := hG)]
  constructor
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨σ', m', e, h, h', -⟩ := h p.vars
    obtain ⟨p', rfl⟩ := MvPolynomial.exists_rename_eq_of_vars_subset_range _ _ e.coe_injective h
    apply Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset (Set.mem_preimage.mpr <| hp) h'
  rintro p hp hp0
  obtain ⟨σ', m', e, h, h'⟩ := h p.vars
  obtain ⟨p', rfl⟩ := MvPolynomial.exists_rename_eq_of_vars_subset_range _ _ e.coe_injective h
  rw [iff_subset_and_degree_le_eq_and_degree_le₀] at h'
  case hG =>
    intro g
    simpa using hG (g.rename e)
  simp? at hp0 says
    simp only [ne_eq, Embedding.coe_injective, rename_eq_zero_iff_of_injective] at hp0
  replace ⟨g', h⟩ := h'.2 p' hp hp0
  simp? at h says simp only [Set.mem_preimage, ne_eq] at h
  refine ⟨g'.rename e, h.1, by simpa using h.2⟩

theorem weakDiv {ι : Type*} {b : ι → MvPolynomial σ R} (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    ∃ (g : ι →₀ (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R),
      f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ b g + r ∧
        (∀ i, m.withBotDegree (b i) + m.withBotDegree (g i) ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree f) ∧
        ∀ e ∈ r.support, ∀ c : ι →₀ R,
          (∀ i ∈ c.support, m.degree (b i) ≤ e) →
          r.coeff e ≠ c.linearCombination _ (m.leadingCoeff ∘ b) := by
  classical
  by_cases! hb : ∀ e ∈ f.support, ∀ c : ι →₀ R,
    (∀ i ∈ c.support, m.degree (b i) ≤ e) →
      f.coeff e ≠ c.linearCombination _ (m.leadingCoeff ∘ b)
  · exact ⟨0, f, by simp, by simp, hb⟩
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by contrapose hb with rfl; simp
  obtain ⟨deg, hdeg_mem, c, hdeg_mon, hdeg_sum⟩ := hb
  have hdeg_eq_add (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ c.support) :
      deg = m.degree (monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)) + m.degree (b i) := by
    rw [m.degree_monomial, ite_eq_right (by simpa using hi),
      tsub_add_cancel_of_le (hdeg_mon _ hi)]
  obtain ⟨g', r', hg'sum, hg'deg, hg'_mon⟩ :=
    weakDiv (b := b) (f - c.sum (fun i c ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) c *  b i))
  use g' + Finsupp.onFinset c.support (fun i ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)) (by simp), r'
  refine ⟨?_, fun i ↦ ?_, hg'_mon⟩
  · simp? [map_add, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply (MvPolynomial σ R) (Finsupp.onFinset ..)] says
      simp only [map_add, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply (MvPolynomial σ R) (Finsupp.onFinset ..),
        smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, ne_eq, zero_mul, implies_true, Finsupp.sum_onFinset]
    simp only [Finsupp.sum] at hg'sum
    grind
  simp_rw [map_add] at ⊢ hg'deg
  apply le_trans <| add_le_add_right (m.withBotDegree_add_le ..) _
  rw [add_max, max_le_iff]
  have (i : ι) :
      m.withBotDegree (b i) + m.withBotDegree (monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)) ≼'[m]
        m.withBotDegree f := by
    by_cases hi : c i = 0
    · simp [hi]
    rw [m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff f |>.mpr hf0]
    trans m.toWithBotSyn ↑(m.degree (b i) + m.degree (monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)))
    · simp_rw [WithBot.coe_add, map_add]
      gcongr <;> exact m.toWithBotSyn_monotone (m.withBotDegree_le_coe_degree _)
    rw [add_comm]
    apply le_of_eq_of_le <| congrArg _ <| congrArg _ (hdeg_eq_add i (by simpa using hi)).symm
    simp_rw [m.toWithBotSyn_apply_coe, WithBot.coe_le_coe]
    exact m.le_degree_of_mem_support hdeg_mem
  refine ⟨?_, by simpa using this i⟩
  apply le_trans <| hg'deg ..
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply le_trans <| m.withBotDegree_add_le ..
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, withBotDegree_neg, sup_le_iff, Std.le_refl, true_and]
  apply le_trans <| m.withBotDegree_sum_le ..
  rw [Finset.sup_le_iff]
  rintro i -
  apply le_trans <| m.withBotDegree_mul_le ..
  simpa only [add_comm] using this i
termination_by toColex <| f.support.image m.toSyn
decreasing_by
  simp_rw [Finset.Colex.lt_iff, ofColex_toColex,
    ← m.toSyn.coe_toEquiv, Equiv.image_eq_preimage_symm_of_finset, m.toSyn.coe_toEquiv_symm,
    Finset.mem_preimage]
  use m.toSyn deg
  refine ⟨?_, by simp [hdeg_mem], ?_⟩
  · intro e he
    simp only [mem_support_iff, coeff_sub, ne_eq]
    suffices m.toSyn.symm e ∉ support (c.sum fun i c ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) c * b i) by
      grind
    apply m.notMem_support_of_degree_lt'
    rw [m.toSyn.apply_symm_apply]
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le' he
    apply le_trans m.degree_sum_le
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro i hi
    nth_rw 2 [hdeg_eq_add i hi]
    exact m.degree_mul_le
  simp [hdeg_sum, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum,
      sub_eq_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_add_of_le (hdeg_mon i (by simpa using hi))
  rw [hd, add_tsub_cancel_left, mul_comm _ (b i), coeff_mul_monomial, leadingCoeff, mul_comm]

theorem weakDiv_set {B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (∃ (g : B →₀ (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R),
      f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ (fun (b : B) ↦ (b : MvPolynomial σ R)) g + r ∧
      (∀ (b : B), m.withBotDegree b.val + m.withBotDegree (g b) ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree f) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ r.support, ∀ c : B →₀ R,
        (∀ b ∈ c.support, m.degree b.val ≤ e) →
        r.coeff e ≠ c.linearCombination _ (m.leadingCoeff ∘ Subtype.val))) := by
  obtain ⟨g, r, H⟩ := m.weakDiv (b := fun (p : B) ↦ p) f
  refine ⟨g, r, H.1, H.2.1, fun e he b hb ↦ H.2.2 e he b hb⟩

theorem remainder_eq_zero_iff_mem_ideal
    {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)}
    {r : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.IsGroebnerBasis G I)
    (hr : m.IsRemainder p G r) :
    r = 0 ↔ p ∈ I := by
  constructor
  · rw [← mem_ideal_iff h.subset hr]
    simp_intro ..
  intro h_p_mem
  rcases h with ⟨h_G', h_span⟩
  have ⟨⟨q, h_p_eq_sum_r, h_r_reduced⟩, h_degree⟩ := hr
  rw [h_p_eq_sum_r, Ideal.add_mem_iff_right] at h_p_mem
  on_goal 2 =>
    exact Ideal.span_le.mpr h_G' <| (Finsupp.mem_span_iff_linearCombination ..).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩
  apply Set.mem_image_of_mem m.leadingTerm at h_p_mem
  apply Submodule.mem_span_of_mem (R := MvPolynomial σ R) at h_p_mem
  contrapose! h_p_mem with h_r_ne_zero
  simpa [← h_span, leadingTerm, leadingCoeff, Ideal.span] using
    term_notMem_span_leadingTerm hr (m.degree r) (by simp [h_r_ne_zero])

theorem isRemainder_zero_iff_mem_ideal {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
    {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)}
    (h : m.IsGroebnerBasis G I) :
    m.IsRemainder p G 0 ↔ p ∈ I := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hr
    apply (remainder_eq_zero_iff_mem_ideal h hr).mp rfl
  · intro hp
    have ⟨g, r, hsum, hdeg, hdeg'⟩ := m.weakDiv_set (B := G) p
    suffices r = 0 by
      subst this
      refine ⟨⟨g, by grind⟩, by simp⟩
    contrapose! hdeg' with hr0
    refine ⟨m.degree r, m.degree_mem_support hr0, ?_⟩
    unfold IsGroebnerBasis at h
    have : r ∈ I := by
      rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add'] at hsum
      subst hsum
      apply Ideal.sub_mem _ hp
      simp [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
      apply Submodule.finsuppSum_mem
      intro b _
      exact I.mul_mem_left _ <| h.1 b.prop
    apply Set.mem_image_of_mem m.leadingTerm at this
    apply Ideal.subset_span at this
    rw [h.2, SetLike.mem_coe] at this
    convert_to _ ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (m.leadingTerm ∘ Subtype.val : G → _)) at this
    · simp [Set.range_comp]
    rw [Finsupp.mem_ideal_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp] at this
    rcases this with ⟨g', hg'⟩
    simp at hg'
    use Finsupp.onFinset g'.support
      (fun b ↦ (g' b * monomial (m.degree b.val) 1).coeff (m.degree r))
      (fun a ha ↦ by
        by_contra h
        have h0 : g' a = 0 := by simpa using h
        exact ha (by rw [h0, zero_mul, coeff_zero]))
    constructor
    · simp [coeff_mul_monomial']
      grind
    apply_fun (·.coeff (m.degree r)) at hg'
    have key : ∀ a : G, coeff (m.degree r) (g' a * m.leadingTerm a.val) =
        coeff (m.degree r) (g' a * monomial (m.degree a.val) 1) * m.leadingCoeff a.val := by
      intro a
      rw [leadingTerm, ← mul_one (m.leadingCoeff a.val), ← C_mul_monomial, mul_left_comm,
        coeff_C_mul, mul_one, mul_comm]
    simp only [Finsupp.sum, coeff_sum, key] at hg'
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum_onFinset]
    · simp only [smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [hg']
      simp [leadingTerm, leadingCoeff]
    · intro a
      simp

theorem ideal_eq_span {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)}
    (h : m.IsGroebnerBasis G I) :
    I = Ideal.span G := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    rw [← isRemainder_zero_iff_mem_ideal h] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨f, h_eq, h_deg⟩, h_remain⟩ := hp
    rw [h_eq, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, add_zero]
    apply Ideal.sum_mem
    intro g hg
    rcases g with ⟨g, gG'⟩
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span gG')
  · intro p hp
    suffices Ideal.span ↑G ≤ I from this hp
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro p hp'
    exact h.subset hp'

def IsRemainder {σ : Type*} (m : MonomialOrder σ) {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R) :=
  (∃ (g : B →₀ MvPolynomial σ R),
    f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ (fun (b : B) ↦ b.val) g + r ∧
    ∀ (b : B),
      m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree b.val) + m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (g b)) ≤
        m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree f)) ∧

section CommSemiring
variable {σ : Type*} {m : MonomialOrder σ}

variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
variable (f p : MvPolynomial σ R) (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R)

lemma isRemainder_def' (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))
    (r : MvPolynomial σ R) : m.IsRemainder p B r ↔
      (∃ (g : MvPolynomial σ R →₀ MvPolynomial σ R),
        ↑g.support ⊆ B ∧
        p = Finsupp.linearCombination _ id g + r ∧
        ∀ b ∈ B,
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree b) + m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (g b)) ≤
            m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree p)) ∧
      ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ g' ∈ B, g' ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree g' ≤ c) := by
  apply and_congr_left'
  rw [Function.Surjective.exists (Finsupp.restrictSupportEquiv B (MvPolynomial σ R)).surjective]
  conv in Finsupp.linearCombination _ _ _ =>
    simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination, Finsupp.restrictSupportEquiv_apply, Finsupp.coe_lsum,
      LinearMap.coe_smulRight, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq, smul_eq_mul,
      Finsupp.sum_subtypeDomain_index (p := (· ∈ B)) (h := fun a b ↦ b * a) x.2]
  simp [Subtype.exists, exists_prop, -exists_and_left, and_assoc, Finsupp.linearCombination]

lemma isRemainder_def'' (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))
    (r : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.IsRemainder p B r ↔
      (∃ (g : MvPolynomial σ R → MvPolynomial σ R) (B' : Finset (MvPolynomial σ R)),
        ↑B' ⊆ B ∧
        p = B'.sum (fun x => g x * x) + r ∧
        ∀ b' ∈ B',
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (b' : MvPolynomial σ R)) +
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (g b')) ≤
            m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree p)) ∧
      ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ b ∈ B, b ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree b ≤ c) := by
  classical
  rw [isRemainder_def']
  apply and_congr_left
  rintro -
  constructor
  · intro ⟨g, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
    use g.toFun, g.support
    refine ⟨h₁, by rwa [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] at h₂, ?_⟩
    intro g' hg'
    exact h₃ g' (Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset hg' h₁)
  · intro ⟨g, B', h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
    use Finsupp.onFinset B' (fun b' => if b' ∈ B' then g b' else 0) (by simp_intro ..)
    split_ands
    · simp_intro b' hb'
      exact Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset hb'.1 h₁
    · rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, h₂, Finsupp.support_onFinset]
      congr 1
      simp only [ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff, not_imp, Finset.filter_and, Std.le_refl,
          Finset.filter_mem_eq_of_subset, Finset.inter_filter, Finset.inter_self,
          Finsupp.onFinset_apply, id_eq, smul_eq_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_mem,
          Finset.filter_inter]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b' _
      by_cases hb' : g b' = 0 <;> simp [hb']
    · intro b hb
      by_cases hbB' : b ∈ B' <;> simp [hbB', h₃]

lemma isRemainder_zero {r : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : m.IsRemainder 0 B r) : r = 0 := by

      toWithBotSyn_apply_eq_bot_iff, withBotDegree_eq_bot_iff] at hg
  rcases hg with hg | hg <;> simp [hg]

lemma term_notMem_span_span_monomial {p r : MvPolynomial σ R}
    {B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} (h : m.IsRemainder p B r) :

      MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hs, imp_false, Decidable.not_not, Set.mem_image,
      Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, exists_exists_and_eq_and, forall_eq', not_exists,

lemma term_notMem_span_leadingTerm {p r : MvPolynomial σ R}

lemma withBotDegree_remainder_le (h : m.IsRemainder f B r) :
    m.withBotDegree r ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree f := by
  wlog! hf : f ≠ 0
  · simp [hf, isRemainder_zero_iff .. |>.mp <| hf ▸ h]
  wlog! hr : r ≠ 0
  · simp [hr]

  contrapose! hsum
  apply ne_of_lt
  rw [withBotDegree_add_of_right_lt]
  · exact hsum
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt withBotDegree_sum_le
  rw [Finset.sup_lt_iff (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr (by simpa))]
  simp only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, ne_eq, LinearMap.coe_smulRight, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq,
      smul_eq_mul]
  rintro b -
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt <| m.withBotDegree_mul_le (g b) b
  simpa [add_comm] using lt_of_le_of_lt (h b) hsum

lemma _root_.MonomialOrder.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_withBotDegree

lemma leadingTerm_mem_span_leadingTerm
    (h : m.IsRemainder f B r) (hfr : m.withBotDegree f ≠ m.withBotDegree r) :
    m.leadingTerm f ∈ Ideal.span (m.leadingTerm '' B) := by
  classical
  have this := h
  rw [isRemainder_def''] at this
  obtain ⟨⟨g, B', hB, hsum, hdeg⟩, -⟩ := this
  apply_fun (·.coeff (m.degree f)) at hsum
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_add, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_withBotDegree <| h.withBotDegree_remainder_lt_iff.mpr hfr,
      add_zero] at hsum
  rw [leadingTerm, leadingCoeff, hsum, map_sum]
  apply Ideal.sum_mem
  intro b hb
  specialize hdeg b hb
  rw [le_iff_lt_or_eq'] at hdeg
  rcases hdeg with hlt | heq
  · convert Ideal.zero_mem _
    rw [monomial_eq_zero, mul_comm]
    apply coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_withBotDegree
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by simpa [map_add] using m.withBotDegree_mul_le b (g b)) (hlt)
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := h.ne_zero_of_ne_remainder (by grind)
  obtain ⟨hb0, hgb0⟩ : b ≠ 0 ∧ g b ≠ 0 := by
    contrapose! +distrib heq
    rcases heq with heq | heq <;> simp [heq, hf0]
  rw [m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff .. |>.mpr hb0,
    m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff .. |>.mpr hgb0,
    m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff .. |>.mpr hf0, add_comm,
    ← map_add, ← WithBot.coe_add, m.toWithBotSyn.apply_eq_iff_eq, WithBot.coe_eq_coe] at heq
  rw [heq, coeff_mul_of_degree_add, ← monomial_mul_monomial, ← leadingTerm.eq_1 m b]
  apply Ideal.mul_mem_left
  apply Ideal.subset_span
  exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ <| hB hb

    {r : MvPolynomial σ R} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {p : MvPolynomial σ R}

    rw [h_eq]

  obtain ⟨⟨f, h_eq, h_deg⟩, h_remain⟩ := hpBr

  exact fun _ _ ↦ Ideal.mul_mem_left I _ (Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset (by simp) hBI)

theorem weakDiv {ι : Type*} {b : ι → MvPolynomial σ R} (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    ∃ (g : ι →₀ (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R),
      f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ b g + r ∧
        (∀ i, m.withBotDegree (b i) + m.withBotDegree (g i) ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree f) ∧
        ∀ e ∈ r.support, ∀ c : ι →₀ R,
          (∀ i ∈ c.support, m.degree (b i) ≤ e) →
          r.coeff e ≠ c.linearCombination _ (m.leadingCoeff ∘ b) := by
  classical
  by_cases! hb : ∀ e ∈ f.support, ∀ c : ι →₀ R,
    (∀ i ∈ c.support, m.degree (b i) ≤ e) →
      f.coeff e ≠ c.linearCombination _ (m.leadingCoeff ∘ b)
  · exact ⟨0, f, by simp, by simp, hb⟩
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by contrapose hb with rfl; simp
  obtain ⟨deg, hdeg_mem, c, hdeg_mon, hdeg_sum⟩ := hb
  have hdeg_eq_add (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ c.support) :
      deg = m.degree (monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)) + m.degree (b i) := by
    rw [m.degree_monomial, ite_eq_right (by simpa using hi),
      tsub_add_cancel_of_le (hdeg_mon _ hi)]
  obtain ⟨g', r', hg'sum, hg'deg, hg'_mon⟩ :=
    weakDiv (b := b) (f - c.sum (fun i c ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) c *  b i))
  use g' + Finsupp.onFinset c.support (fun i ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)) (by simp), r'
  refine ⟨?_, fun i ↦ ?_, hg'_mon⟩
  · simp only [map_add, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply (MvPolynomial σ R) (Finsupp.onFinset ..),
        smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, ne_eq, zero_mul, implies_true, Finsupp.sum_onFinset]
    simp only [Finsupp.sum] at hg'sum
    grind
  simp_rw [map_add] at ⊢ hg'deg
  apply le_trans <| add_le_add_right (m.withBotDegree_add_le ..) _
  rw [add_max, max_le_iff]
  have (i : ι) :
      m.withBotDegree (b i) + m.withBotDegree (monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)) ≼'[m]
        m.withBotDegree f := by
    by_cases hi : c i = 0
    · simp [hi]
    rw [m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff f |>.mpr hf0]
    trans m.toWithBotSyn ↑(m.degree (b i) + m.degree (monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)))
    · simp_rw [WithBot.coe_add, map_add]
      gcongr <;> exact m.toWithBotSyn_monotone (m.withBotDegree_le_coe_degree _)
    rw [add_comm]
    apply le_of_eq_of_le <| congrArg _ <| congrArg _ (hdeg_eq_add i (by simpa using hi)).symm
    simp_rw [m.toWithBotSyn_apply_coe, WithBot.coe_le_coe]
    exact m.le_degree_of_mem_support hdeg_mem
  refine ⟨?_, by simpa using this i⟩
  apply le_trans <| hg'deg ..
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply le_trans <| m.withBotDegree_add_le ..
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, withBotDegree_neg, sup_le_iff, Std.le_refl, true_and]
  apply le_trans <| m.withBotDegree_sum_le ..
  rw [Finset.sup_le_iff]
  rintro i -
  apply le_trans <| m.withBotDegree_mul_le ..
  simpa only [add_comm] using this i
termination_by toColex <| f.support.image m.toSyn
decreasing_by
  simp_rw [Finset.Colex.lt_iff, ofColex_toColex,
    ← m.toSyn.coe_toEquiv, Equiv.image_eq_preimage_symm_of_finset, m.toSyn.coe_toEquiv_symm,
    Finset.mem_preimage]
  use m.toSyn deg
  refine ⟨?_, by simp [hdeg_mem], ?_⟩
  · intro e he
    simp only [mem_support_iff, coeff_sub, ne_eq]
    suffices m.toSyn.symm e ∉ support (c.sum fun i c ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) c * b i) by
      grind
    apply m.notMem_support_of_degree_lt'
    rw [m.toSyn.apply_symm_apply]
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le' he
    apply le_trans m.degree_sum_le
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro i hi
    nth_rw 2 [hdeg_eq_add i hi]
    exact m.degree_mul_le
  simp [hdeg_sum, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum,
      sub_eq_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have e : coeff (m.degree (b i) + (deg - m.degree (b i)))
      (b i * monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)) = coeff (m.degree (b i)) (b i) * c i :=
    coeff_mul_monomial ..
  rw [add_tsub_cancel_of_le (hdeg_mon _ (by simpa using hi))] at e
  rw [mul_comm _ (b i), e, leadingCoeff, mul_comm]

theorem weakDiv_set {B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (∃ (g : B →₀ (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R),
      f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ (fun (b : B) ↦ (b : MvPolynomial σ R)) g + r ∧
      (∀ (b : B), m.withBotDegree b.val + m.withBotDegree (g b) ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree f) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ r.support, ∀ c : B →₀ R,
        (∀ b ∈ c.support, m.degree b.val ≤ e) →
        r.coeff e ≠ c.linearCombination _ (m.leadingCoeff ∘ Subtype.val))) := by
  obtain ⟨g, r, H⟩ := m.weakDiv (b := fun (p : B) ↦ p) f
  refine ⟨g, r, H.1, H.2.1, fun e he b hb ↦ H.2.2 e he b hb⟩

    [CommSemiring R] (G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) :=

theorem remainder_eq_zero_iff_mem_ideal
    {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)}
    {r : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.IsGroebnerBasis G I)
    (hr : m.IsRemainder p G r) :
    r = 0 ↔ p ∈ I := by
  constructor
  · rw [← mem_ideal_iff h.subset hr]
    simp_intro ..
  intro h_p_mem
  rcases h with ⟨h_G', h_span⟩
  have ⟨⟨q, h_p_eq_sum_r, h_r_reduced⟩, h_degree⟩ := hr
  rw [h_p_eq_sum_r, Ideal.add_mem_iff_right] at h_p_mem
  on_goal 2 =>
    exact Ideal.span_le.mpr h_G' <| (Finsupp.mem_span_iff_linearCombination ..).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩
  apply Set.mem_image_of_mem m.leadingTerm at h_p_mem
  apply Submodule.mem_span_of_mem (R := MvPolynomial σ R) at h_p_mem
  contrapose! h_p_mem with h_r_ne_zero
  simpa [← h_span, leadingTerm, leadingCoeff, Ideal.span] using
    term_notMem_span_leadingTerm hr (m.degree r) (by simp [h_r_ne_zero])

theorem isRemainder_zero_iff_mem_ideal {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
    {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)}
    (h : m.IsGroebnerBasis G I) :
    m.IsRemainder p G 0 ↔ p ∈ I := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hr
    apply (remainder_eq_zero_iff_mem_ideal h hr).mp rfl
  · intro hp
    have ⟨g, r, hsum, hdeg, hdeg'⟩ := m.weakDiv_set (B := G) p
    suffices r = 0 by
      subst this
      refine ⟨⟨g, by grind⟩, by simp⟩
    contrapose! hdeg' with hr0
    refine ⟨m.degree r, m.degree_mem_support hr0, ?_⟩
    unfold IsGroebnerBasis at h
    have : r ∈ I := by
      rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add'] at hsum
      subst hsum
      apply Ideal.sub_mem _ hp
      simp [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
      apply Submodule.finsuppSum_mem
      intro b _
      exact I.mul_mem_left _ <| h.1 b.prop
    apply Set.mem_image_of_mem m.leadingTerm at this
    apply Ideal.subset_span at this
    rw [h.2, SetLike.mem_coe] at this
    convert_to _ ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (m.leadingTerm ∘ Subtype.val : G → _)) at this
    · simp [Set.range_comp]
    rw [Finsupp.mem_ideal_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp] at this
    rcases this with ⟨g', hg'⟩
    simp at hg'
    use Finsupp.onFinset g'.support
      (fun b ↦ (g' b * monomial (m.degree b.val) 1).coeff (m.degree r))
      (fun _ ↦ not_imp_not.mp <| by simp_intro _)
    constructor
    · simp [coeff_mul_monomial']
      grind
    apply_fun (·.coeff (m.degree r)) at hg'
    simp [Finsupp.sum, leadingCoeff] at hg'
    simp only [MvPolynomial.coeff_sum] at hg'
    have h2 : coeff (m.degree r) (m.leadingTerm r) = coeff (m.degree r) r := by
      simp [leadingTerm, leadingCoeff, coeff_monomial]
    rw [h2] at hg'
    simp [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
    rw [← hg']
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b hb
    simp only [leadingTerm, coeff_mul_monomial']
    split_ifs <;> simp

proof:

lemma isRemainder_insert_zero_iff_isRemainder (p : MvPolynomial σ R)

    m.IsRemainder p (insert 0 B) r ↔ m.IsRemainder p B r := by

    · intro h c hc b hb hb0
      exact h c hc b (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hb) hb0
    · intro h c hc b hb hb0

  on_goal 2 => simp [Function.Injective]
  congr! with g

lemma isRemainder_iff_degree (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, m.leadingCoeff b ∈ nonZeroDivisors _) :

def IsGroebnerBasis {σ : Type*} {m : MonomialOrder σ} {R : Type*}
    [CommSemiring R] (G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) :=
  G ⊆ I ∧ Ideal.span (m.leadingTerm '' ↑I) = Ideal.span (m.leadingTerm '' G)

variable {σ : Type*} {m : MonomialOrder σ} {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]

lemma subset {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} {I} (h : m.IsGroebnerBasis G I) : G ⊆ I := h.1

lemma span_leadingTerm_image {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} {I} (h : m.IsGroebnerBasis G I) :
    Ideal.span (m.leadingTerm '' ↑I) = Ideal.span (m.leadingTerm '' G) := h.2

lemma iff_subset (G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    m.IsGroebnerBasis G I ↔
      G ⊆ I ∧ m.leadingTerm '' ↑I ⊆ (Ideal.span (m.leadingTerm '' G) : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h.span_leadingTerm_image]
    exact ⟨h.subset, Ideal.subset_span⟩
  intro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  refine ⟨h₁, ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · rwa [Ideal.span_le]
  apply Ideal.span_mono
  exact Set.image_mono h₁

    {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R))
    (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, IsUnit (m.leadingCoeff g)) :
    m.IsGroebnerBasis G I ↔
      G ⊆ I ∧ ∀ p ∈ I, p ≠ 0 → ∃ g ∈ G, m.degree g ≤ m.degree p := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    exists h.subset
    intro p hp hp0
    apply Set.mem_image_of_mem m.leadingTerm at hp
    apply Ideal.subset_span at hp
    rw [h.span_leadingTerm_image, SetLike.mem_coe,
      m.span_leadingTerm_eq_span_monomial (by simp_intro .. [hG]),
      ← Set.image_image (monomial · 1) _ _, mem_ideal_span_monomial_image,
      m.support_leadingTerm' hp0] at hp
    simpa using hp
  rintro ⟨hG', h_degree⟩
  rw [iff_subset]
  constructor
  · exact hG'
  intro p' hp
  rcases hp with ⟨p, hp', hp'₁⟩
  rw [←hp'₁, leadingTerm, SetLike.mem_coe,
    m.span_leadingTerm_eq_span_monomial (by simp_intro .. [hG]),
    ← Set.image_image (monomial · 1) _ _, mem_ideal_span_monomial_image]
  intro j hj
  specialize h_degree p
  simp_all [MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff]

    {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)}
    (h : m.IsGroebnerBasis G I) (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, IsUnit (m.leadingCoeff g)) :
    Ideal.span (m.leadingTerm '' ↑G) =
    Ideal.span ((fun p ↦ monomial (m.degree p) (1 : R)) '' (I \ {(0 : MvPolynomial σ R)})) := by
  classical
  wlog hR : Nontrivial R
  · rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hR
    exact ((Submodule.subsingleton_iff _).mpr inferInstance).elim _ _
  rw [m.span_leadingTerm_eq_span_monomial (B := (↑G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))) hG]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    refine subset_trans ?_ Submodule.subset_span
    apply Set.image_mono
    apply Set.subset_sdiff_singleton h.subset
    contrapose! hG
    use 0
    simpa
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro x
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_sdiff, SetLike.mem_coe, Set.mem_singleton_iff, ne_eq,
      forall_exists_index, and_imp]
    intro y hy hy0 hxy
    rw [← hxy, ← Set.image_image (monomial · 1) _ _, mem_ideal_span_monomial_image]
    simpa using ((iff_subset_and_degree_le_eq_and_degree_le _ hG).mp h).2 y hy hy0

end CommSemiring

theorem iff_subset_and_degree_le_eq_and_degree_le

    m.IsGroebnerBasis G I ↔

    intro p hp hp0

    apply Ideal.subset_span at hp
    rw [h.span_leadingTerm_image, SetLike.mem_coe,

      m.support_leadingTerm' hp0] at hp

  rw [iff_subset]
  constructor

  classical
  wlog hR : Nontrivial R

  rw [m.span_leadingTerm_eq_span_monomial (B := (↑G : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))) hG]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    refine subset_trans ?_ Submodule.subset_span
    apply Set.image_mono
    apply Set.subset_sdiff_singleton h.subset
    contrapose! hG
    use 0
    simpa
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro x

    intro y hy hy0 hxy

proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlt := h
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hsum, hdeg⟩, -⟩ := hlt
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := h.ne_zero_of_ne_remainder (by grind)

  apply Ideal.subset_span

lemma isRemainder_zero {r : MvPolynomial σ R}

  convert zero_add r
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero (f := fun x ↦ g x * x.val)
  intro x _

      toWithBotSyn_apply_eq_bot_iff, withBotDegree_eq_bot_iff] at hg

lemma isRemainder_iff_degree (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, m.leadingCoeff b ∈ nonZeroDivisors _) :

    ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ b ∈ B, b ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree b ≤ c) := by
  classical
  wlog! hf : f = 0
  · simp_rw [IsRemainder, ← map_add,
        ← m.withBotDegree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors (hB _ (Subtype.prop _)),
       withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_iff]
    simp only [hf, IsEmpty.forall_iff, and_true, Subtype.forall, ne_eq]
  simp_rw [hf, isRemainder_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨⟨0, by simp [h]⟩, by simp [h]⟩

  simp_rw [m.degree_zero, m.toSyn.map_zero, ← m.eq_zero_iff, AddEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff,

lemma isRemainder_insert_zero_iff_isRemainder (p : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.IsRemainder p (insert 0 B) r ↔ m.IsRemainder p B r := by
  unfold IsRemainder
  refine and_congr ?_ ?_
  swap
  · simp
  rw [(Finsupp.comapDomain_surjective (f := (⟨·.val, by simp⟩ : B → ↑(insert 0 B))) ?_).exists]
  on_goal 2 => simp [Function.Injective]
  congr! with g
  on_goal 2 => aesop
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_comapDomain, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  convert (g.support.sum_preimage ..).symm
  intro x hx hx'
  simp [or_iff_not_imp_right.mp x.prop (by simpa using hx')]

@[simp]
lemma isRemainder_sdiff_singleton_zero_iff_isRemainder (p : MvPolynomial σ R)
  (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R) :
  m.IsRemainder p (B \ {0}) r ↔ m.IsRemainder p B r := by
  by_cases h : 0 ∈ B
  · rw [←isRemainder_insert_zero_iff_isRemainder, show insert 0 (B \ {0}) = B by simp [h]]
  · simp [h]

variable {B} in
lemma isRemainder_zero {r : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : m.IsRemainder 0 B r) : r = 0 := by
  classical
  unfold IsRemainder at h
  obtain ⟨⟨g, h0sumg, hg⟩, hr⟩ := h
  rw [h0sumg, eq_comm]
  convert zero_add r
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero (f := fun x ↦ g x * x.val)
  intro x _
  specialize hg x
  simp only [withBotDegree_zero, toWithBotSyn_apply_bot, le_bot_iff, WithBot.add_eq_bot,
      toWithBotSyn_apply_eq_bot_iff, withBotDegree_eq_bot_iff] at hg
  rcases hg with hg | hg <;> simp [hg]

@[simp]
lemma isRemainder_zero_iff :
    m.IsRemainder 0 B r ↔ r = 0 := by
  refine ⟨isRemainder_zero, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  exact ⟨⟨0, by simp [h]⟩, by simp [h]⟩

variable {f B r} in
lemma isRemainder_iff_degree (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, m.leadingCoeff b ∈ nonZeroDivisors _) :
    m.IsRemainder f B r ↔
    (∃ (g : B →₀ MvPolynomial σ R),
      f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ (fun (b : B) ↦ b.val) g + r ∧
      ∀ (b : B), m.toSyn (m.degree (b.val * (g b))) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree f)) ∧
    ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ b ∈ B, b ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree b ≤ c) := by
  classical
  wlog! hf : f = 0
  · simp_rw [IsRemainder, ← map_add,
        ← m.withBotDegree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors (hB _ (Subtype.prop _)),
       withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_iff]
    simp only [hf, IsEmpty.forall_iff, and_true, Subtype.forall, ne_eq]
  simp_rw [hf, isRemainder_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨⟨0, by simp [h]⟩, by simp [h]⟩
  rintro ⟨⟨g, h0sumg, hg⟩, hr⟩
  simp_rw [m.degree_zero, m.toSyn.map_zero, ← m.eq_zero_iff, AddEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff,
    mul_comm _ (g _)] at hg
  simp_rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, smul_eq_mul] at h0sumg
  have h_deg_r_eq_0 : m.degree r = 0 := by
    apply congrArg m.degree at h0sumg
    contrapose! h0sumg
    rw [degree_zero, ne_comm, ← AddEquiv.map_ne_zero_iff m.toSyn, ← m.toSyn_lt_iff_ne_zero]
    rw [← AddEquiv.map_ne_zero_iff m.toSyn, ← m.toSyn_lt_iff_ne_zero] at h0sumg
    rwa [degree_add_eq_right_of_lt]
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt m.degree_sum_le
    simpa [hg] using lt_of_le_of_lt Finset.sup_const_le h0sumg
  by_contra! hr0
  suffices ∀ b, g b * b = 0 by simp [this, hr0.symm] at h0sumg
  intro b
  by_contra! hgb
  obtain ⟨h_gb_ne_0, h_b_ne_0⟩ := ne_zero_and_ne_zero_of_mul hgb
  rw [m.degree_eq_zero_iff.mp h_deg_r_eq_0, support_C,
    ite_eq_right_of_eq_false _ _ (by simp [hr0])] at hr
  specialize hr 0 (by simp) b b.2 h_b_ne_0
  specialize hg b
  rw [m.degree_mul_of_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors h_gb_ne_0 (hB b b.2)] at hg
  rw [← hg] at hr
  simp at hr

lemma isRemainder_iff_degree₀
    (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, m.leadingCoeff b ∈ nonZeroDivisors _ ∨ b = 0) :
    m.IsRemainder f B r ↔
    (∃ (g : B →₀ MvPolynomial σ R),
      f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ (fun (b : B) ↦ b.val) g + r ∧
      ∀ (b : B), m.toSyn (m.degree (b.val * (g b))) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree f)) ∧
    ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ b ∈ B, b ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree b ≤ c) := by
  rw [← isRemainder_sdiff_singleton_zero_iff_isRemainder,
    isRemainder_iff_degree (hB := by
      intro _ _
      exact or_iff_not_imp_right.mp (hB _ (by simp_all)) (by simp_all)),
    Function.Surjective.exists <|
      Finsupp.comapDomain_surjective (f := (⟨·.val, by aesop⟩ : ↑(B \ {0}) → ↑B)) ?_]
  on_goal 2 => simp [Function.Injective]
  refine and_congr (exists_congr fun x => ?_) ?_
  · refine and_congr ?_ ?_
    · rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_comapDomain, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
      refine iff_of_eq (congrArg (f = · + r) ?_)
      convert (x.support.sum_preimage ..)
      · simp
      intro x hx hx'
      simp at hx'
      simp [hx']
    · constructor
      · intro h b
        by_cases hb : b.val = 0
        · simp [hb]
        simpa using h ⟨b.val, by simpa⟩
      · intro h b
        exact h _
  · constructor
    · intro h c hc b hb hb0
      exact h c hc b ⟨hb, hb0⟩ hb0
    · intro h c hc b hb hb0
      exact h c hc b hb.1 hb0

name: MonomialOrder.weakDiv
statement:
theorem weakDiv {ι : Type*} {b : ι → MvPolynomial σ R} (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    ∃ (g : ι →₀ (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R),
      f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ b g + r ∧
        (∀ i, m.withBotDegree (b i) + m.withBotDegree (g i) ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree f) ∧
        ∀ e ∈ r.support, ∀ c : ι →₀ R,
          (∀ i ∈ c.support, m.degree (b i) ≤ e) →
          r.coeff e ≠ c.linearCombination _ (m.leadingCoeff ∘ b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases! hb : ∀ e ∈ f.support, ∀ c : ι →₀ R,
    (∀ i ∈ c.support, m.degree (b i) ≤ e) →
      f.coeff e ≠ c.linearCombination _ (m.leadingCoeff ∘ b)
  · exact ⟨0, f, by simp, by simp, hb⟩
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by contrapose hb with rfl; simp
  obtain ⟨deg, hdeg_mem, c, hdeg_mon, hdeg_sum⟩ := hb
  have hdeg_eq_add (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ c.support) :
      deg = m.degree (monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)) + m.degree (b i) := by
    rw [m.degree_monomial, ite_eq_right (by simpa using hi),
      tsub_add_cancel_of_le (hdeg_mon _ hi)]
  have hlt : ∀ a, m.toSyn deg < m.toSyn a →
      coeff a (c.sum (fun i c ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) c * b i)) = 0 := by
    intro a ha
    rw [Finsupp.sum, coeff_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    apply m.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (m.degree_mul_le ..) ?_
    rw [← hdeg_eq_add i hi]
    exact ha
  have heq : coeff deg (c.sum (fun i c ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) c * b i)) =
      coeff deg f := by
    rw [Finsupp.sum, coeff_sum, hdeg_sum, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
    unfold Finsupp.sum
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [coeff_monomial_mul', if_pos tsub_le_self,
      tsub_tsub_cancel_of_le (hdeg_mon i hi)]
    simp [leadingCoeff]
  have hdec : wfMeasure m (f - c.sum (fun i c ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) c * b i))
      < wfMeasure m f :=
    wfMeasure_lt _ _ deg (by simpa using hdeg_mem) (by rw [coeff_sub, heq, sub_self])
      (fun a ha => by rw [coeff_sub, hlt a ha, sub_zero])
  obtain ⟨g', r', hg'sum, hg'deg, hg'_mon⟩ :=
    weakDiv (b := b) (f - c.sum (fun i c ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) c *  b i))
  use g' + Finsupp.onFinset c.support (fun i ↦ monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)) (by simp), r'
  refine ⟨?_, fun i ↦ ?_, hg'_mon⟩
  · simp only [map_add, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply (MvPolynomial σ R) (Finsupp.onFinset ..),
        smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, ne_eq, zero_mul, implies_true, Finsupp.sum_onFinset]
    simp only [Finsupp.sum] at hg'sum
    grind
  simp_rw [map_add] at ⊢ hg'deg
  apply le_trans <| add_le_add_right (m.withBotDegree_add_le ..) _
  rw [add_max, max_le_iff]
  have (i : ι) :
      m.withBotDegree (b i) + m.withBotDegree (monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)) ≼'[m]
        m.withBotDegree f := by
    by_cases hi : c i = 0
    · simp [hi]
    rw [m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff f |>.mpr hf0]
    trans m.toWithBotSyn ↑(m.degree (b i) + m.degree (monomial (deg - m.degree (b i)) (c i)))
    · simp_rw [WithBot.coe_add, map_add]
      gcongr <;> exact m.toWithBotSyn_monotone (m.withBotDegree_le_coe_degree _)
    rw [add_comm]
    apply le_of_eq_of_le <| congrArg _ <| congrArg _ (hdeg_eq_add i (by simpa using hi)).symm
    simp_rw [m.toWithBotSyn_apply_coe, WithBot.coe_le_coe]
    exact m.le_degree_of_mem_support hdeg_mem
  refine ⟨?_, by simpa using this i⟩
  apply le_trans <| hg'deg ..
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply le_trans <| m.withBotDegree_add_le ..
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, withBotDegree_neg, sup_le_iff, Std.le_refl, true_and]
  apply le_trans <| m.withBotDegree_sum_le ..
  rw [Finset.sup_le_iff]
  rintro i -
  apply le_trans <| m.withBotDegree_mul_le ..
  simpa only [add_comm] using this i
termination_by wfMeasure m f
decreasing_by exact hdec

end MonomialOrder

noncomputable def wfMeasure (m : MonomialOrder σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    Lex ((m.syn)ᵒᵈ →₀ ℕ) := by
  classical
  exact toLex (Finsupp.onFinset (f.support.image (fun a => OrderDual.toDual (m.toSyn a)))
    (fun x => if ∃ a, f.coeff a ≠ 0 ∧ OrderDual.toDual (m.toSyn a) = x then 1 else 0)
    (by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h
      apply hx
      rw [if_neg]
      rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact h (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨a, by simpa using ha, rfl⟩)))

instance wfMeasure_wf : WellFoundedLT (Lex ((m.syn)ᵒᵈ →₀ ℕ)) := by
  haveI : WellFoundedGT (m.syn)ᵒᵈ := inferInstanceAs (WellFoundedLT m.syn)
  exact Finsupp.Lex.wellFoundedLT

lemma wfMeasure_lt (f f' : MvPolynomial σ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (h1 : f.coeff d ≠ 0)
    (h2 : f'.coeff d = 0) (h3 : ∀ a, m.toSyn d < m.toSyn a → f'.coeff a = f.coeff a) :
    wfMeasure m f' < wfMeasure m f := by
  classical
  have key : ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ R) (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
      (∃ a', g.coeff a' ≠ 0 ∧ OrderDual.toDual (m.toSyn a') = OrderDual.toDual (m.toSyn a)) ↔
        g.coeff a ≠ 0 := by
    intro g a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a', h, e⟩
      have : a' = a := by simpa using e
      exact this ▸ h
    · intro h; exact ⟨a, h, rfl⟩
  rw [Finsupp.Lex.lt_iff]
  unfold wfMeasure
  simp only [ofLex_toLex, Finsupp.onFinset_apply]
  refine ⟨OrderDual.toDual (m.toSyn d), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, OrderDual.toDual (m.toSyn a) = j :=
      ⟨m.toSyn.symm (OrderDual.ofDual j), by simp⟩
    have : m.toSyn d < m.toSyn a := hj
    have := h3 a this
    simp only [key, this]
  · simp only [key, h1, h2, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, if_false, if_true]
    norm_num

name: MonomialOrder.weakDiv_set
statement:
theorem weakDiv_set {B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)} (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (∃ (g : B →₀ (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R),
      f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ (fun (b : B) ↦ (b : MvPolynomial σ R)) g + r ∧
      (∀ (b : B), m.withBotDegree b.val + m.withBotDegree (g b) ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree f) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ r.support, ∀ c : B →₀ R,
        (∀ b ∈ c.support, m.degree b.val ≤ e) →
        r.coeff e ≠ c.linearCombination _ (m.leadingCoeff ∘ Subtype.val)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, r, H⟩ := m.weakDiv (b := fun (p : B) ↦ p) f
  refine ⟨g, r, H.1, H.2.1, fun e he b hb ↦ H.2.2 e he b hb⟩

instance _root_.Finset.Colex.wellFoundedLT {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] :
    WellFoundedLT (Colex (Finset α)) :=
  StrictMono.wellFoundedLT (β := Colex (Π₀ _ : α, Nat))
    (f := fun l ↦ toColex <| DFinsupp.mk (ofColex l) (fun _ => (1:ℕ)))
    (by
      intro s t h
      obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := toColex.surjective s
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := toColex.surjective t
      rw [Finset.Colex.toColex_lt_toColex_iff_exists_forall_lt] at h
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hws, H⟩ := h
      have hne : (t \ s).Nonempty := ⟨w, by simp [hw, hws]⟩
      set w' := (t \ s).max' hne with hw'
      have hw'm : w' ∈ t \ s := Finset.max'_mem _ _
      have hww : w ≤ w' := Finset.le_max' _ _ (by simp [hw, hws])
      try simp only [ofColex_toColex]
      rw [DFinsupp.Colex.lt_iff]
      refine ⟨w', fun j hj => ?_, ?_⟩
      · try simp only [DFinsupp.mk_apply]
        have h1 : j ∈ s → j ∈ t := by
          intro hjs
          by_contra hjt
          have := H j hjs hjt
          exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le this hww) (not_lt.2 hj.le)
        have h2 : j ∈ t → j ∈ s := by
          intro hjt
          by_contra hjs
          have := Finset.le_max' (t \ s) j (by simp [hjt, hjs])
          exact absurd hj (not_lt.2 this)
        by_cases hjs : j ∈ s
        · simp [hjs, h1 hjs]
        · have : j ∉ t := fun h => hjs (h2 h)
          simp [hjs, this]
      · try simp only [DFinsupp.mk_apply]
        rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hw'm
        simp [hw'm.1, hw'm.2])

    (∀ i ∈ c.support, m.degree (b i) ≤ e) →

  refine ⟨?_, fun i ↦ ?_, hg'_mon⟩
  · simp only [map_add, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply (MvPolynomial σ R) (Finsupp.onFinset ..),
        smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, ne_eq, zero_mul, implies_true, Finsupp.sum_onFinset]
    simp only [Finsupp.sum] at hg'sum
    grind
  simp_rw [map_add] at ⊢ hg'deg
  apply le_trans <| add_le_add_right (m.withBotDegree_add_le ..) _
